entries.title: Psalms 33:4
segments: The Lord is worthy of universal praise and adoration, not only for what he is in himself, but for what he has manifested of himself to the children of men.  All his works praise him, and his saints bless him.

entries.title: Psalms 33:7
segments: Layeth up the depth; restraineth the waters in their places.

entries.title: Psalms 33:8
segments: The manifestations of God in creation and in providence show that he is infinite, and lay men under obligations to worship him with reverence and holy fear.

entries.title: Psalms 33:9
segments: It was done; the earth was created.

entries.title: Psalms 33:10
segments: The heathen; the nations that know not God.

entries.title: Psalms 33:12
segments: Those who choose God as their portion, his service as their employment, and his favor as their reward, will be truly and for ever blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 33:15
segments: Fashioneth their hearts alike; that is, as the original means, the heart of one as well as of another.  As he is the former of the hearts of all, so he knows the thoughts of all.

entries.title: Psalms 33:19
segments: No reliance can be placed on creatures for safety, without the protecting care and kindness of Jehovah.  He taketh pleasure in those that fear him and that hope in his mercy.
